column1: # homm2 constants work list - numeric constants kept on purpose, one row each,
# with the reason. Every clang-tidy magic number in code, a local table or a
# declaration is open until it is written as a name (an enumerator, a named
# constant, NULL) or a row here keeps it numeric; files config/reviews/constants.tsv
# marks third-party are not counted. `homm2 verify constants --list [FILTER]`
# prints the open ones; the floor never rises (`--update-floor` lowers it).
# Columns (tab-separated; every field is an fnmatch glob, `*` matches anything;
# the first matching row wins): file owner spelling group detail reason.
# owner is the enclosing function, group the finding's category (code,
# local-table, declaration) and detail its source line.
# adventure, world and AI: ADVMGR, EVENTS, Viewwrld, DRAWING, HERO, AI, ARMYGRP, SPELLAI, PHILAI

the terrain painter's retail tuning: its patch count, walk weights (rolled 3..7, drifting by -1..1 and tested against a 0..9 roll), averaging divisors and seed reserve factor
the chain layer's retail tuning: percent odds and thresholds, its quarter and three-quarter map-width bands, steep direction picks and two-column steps

the castle placer's retail tuning: region share thresholds (percent), castle slot and region rank indices, rating weights and distance penalties, the castle footprint and road offsets, and the harbour walk's step limits and odds
the object placer's retail tuning: the monster density scale, map margins, the town footprint, resource-site quotas, appeal weights, distance thresholds and odds
the treasure placer's retail odds and thresholds (percent rolls), guard ratio and map margins
each terrain's decoration chance (retail values) and its roll
